verdict.rationale: Morph's docs say one API key covers its open-weight chat models on a shared, token-billed endpoint, with prefix caching on 'every open source model.' Kimi K3 is the only model actually named, so the catalog's breadth is unproven. missing for 10: an evidenced model list showing Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS or peer families, any proof the catalog is broad and current, and independent corroboration of the model selection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among a broad catalog of current open-weight model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS and peers) on shared serverless endpoints

citations.quote: One API key covers the open-weight chat models and the specialized tools
Kimi K3 serves 1M context through the standard chat completions endpoint, so existing OpenAI code only needs a new `model` string
Prefix caching is on for every open source model.
Anthropic Messages supports the same open source chat models, token billing, and rate limits.
